alert.description: Descriptions mix the muted tone with the foreground so they meet AA contrast on tinted alert surfaces.

arc-carousel.description: Controls center on the visible stage and can be hidden on narrow viewports without removing swipe navigation.

carousel.description: Controls center on the visible stage and showControlsOnMobile hides them below 640px.

code-block.description: The code surface uses a grid by default so newline text nodes no longer add a blank line outside the documentation layout. Numeric syntax tokens also meet AA contrast.

coverflow-carousel.description: Controls center on the visible stage and can be hidden on narrow viewports without removing swipe navigation.

multi-carousel.description: Controls center on the visible stage and can be hidden on narrow viewports; slideAppearance="plain" lets an application card own its frame and hover transform.

peek-carousel.description: Controls center on the visible stage and can be hidden on narrow viewports; slideWidth sets a custom card width.

stack-carousel.description: Controls center on the visible stage and can be hidden on narrow viewports without removing swipe navigation.

thumbnail-carousel.description: Controls center on the visible stage, thumbnails crop to a uniform aspect ratio, and classNames.thumbnailImage targets the actual image.
